subject: Financing for fleet expansion
body: Hi Tom, following our call: Northwind is looking to raise a $12 million senior secured term loan to fund the fleet expansion (40 new tractors). Five-year tenor preferred. Can Corvane run the process? Priya

subject: Northwind Logistics - CIM for review
body: Mark, attached is the Northwind CIM. Sending it over for Larkspur's review ahead of your credit screen. Happy to set up a management call. Tom

subject: Northwind Logistics - opportunity
body: Jane, sending the Northwind materials for Quillfeather's review. Asset-backed, strong customer contracts, fleet as collateral. Tom

subject: Board update - revised ask
body: Tom, Lena - the board approved increasing the request to $15 million so we can include the Dayton warehouse acquisition in the same facility. Updated model to follow. Priya

subject: RE: Northwind Logistics - CIM for review
body: Tom, thanks for including us. Larkspur has completed its review and we will pass on this one; we are at our concentration limit for trucking exposure. Mark

subject: Refinancing our line
body: Tom, Fabrikam would like to refinance the existing working capital line before year end. Can we talk next week? Dana

subject: Intro - Northwind Logistics
body: Owen, per Tom's note, sending the Northwind materials for Basaltline's review. The ask now covers the fleet and a warehouse acquisition. Lena

subject: Quillfeather - Northwind
body: Tom, Quillfeather issued a non-binding indication of interest on Northwind this afternoon, subject to diligence on the warehouse appraisal. Letter attached. Jane

subject: Small change to the ask
body: Tom, we sold two older trucks last week, so we lowered the request to $14 million. Everything else unchanged. Priya
